subject: SOC 2 coverage window, EU hosting boundary, and bridge letter request
messages:
From: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@eurofin.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@eurofin.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report and hosting boundary questions

Hi Jonas,

We're reviewing Redwood for an upcoming procurement for AI inference services. Before we proceed to legal, we need: 

- A copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report (audit period and date of issue).
- A bridge letter or statement that covers the period after the report (if applicable) that confirms there have been no material changes to controls.
- Clarification on hosting: does Redwood host customer inference workloads and backups within EU-only infrastructure for customers that require data residency?
- Details on whether any backups, metrics, or logs that contain customer data are replicated or accessible from non-EU regions.
- Confirmation whether Redwood will sign SCCs (or provide equivalent safeguards) for cross-border transfers.

We'd appreciate the report and any bridge letter or evidence by end of week if possible. If you need a contact in procurement to coordinate the legal paperwork, loop in procure@eurofin.com.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Nowak
Head of Vendor Risk | EuroFin Analytics

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@eurofin.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report and hosting boundary questions

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. I'll coordinate this and can share the SOC 2 Type II PDF plus a bridge letter. Quick clarifications on our side:

- Which audit period do you need covered (calendar year vs trailing 12 months)? We can provide our latest Type II report which covers 2024-06-01 to 2025-05-31, and a bridge letter covering controls from 2025-06-01 through the current date.
- For hosting, are you asking about production inference (request/response) as well as backups and observability metadata? We'll prepare a short diagram showing where inference hosts and backups live for EU-configured customers.

I'll pull the artifacts and loop in Lauren from compliance to draft the bridge letter. If procurement prefers SIG/CAIQ or a transmittable spreadsheet, let me know and we'll include it.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:21:00 +0000
Subject: Internal: draft bridge wording + attachments to send to EuroFin

Jonas — draft below for the bridge letter and attachments we should send. Notes: SOC 2 Type II report we have on file is dated 2025-06-30 (reporting period 2024-06-01 to 2025-05-31). Compliance can sign an attest to controls remaining in place from 2025-06-01 to 2026-06-30 (date to be set to when we deliver).

Suggested bundle to send:
- SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025-05-31.pdf (redacted as appropriate)
- Bridge_Letter_Euro_Transfers_2026-06-30.docx (signed by Head of Compliance)
- Hosting_EU_Dataflow_Diagram.png (shows primary EU region placement, KMS boundary, and backup retention locales)

Key points to include in bridge wording:
- Affirmation that there were no material changes to control design and operation since the end of the audit period.
- Statement about the hosting options: customers can elect EU-only hosting for inference and for backups; by default hosted API customers in EU regions are routed to EU capacity.
- Note on cross-border: operational telemetry (aggregated metrics) may be processed outside the EU in anonymized form; no customer plaintext content is replicated to non-EU regions unless explicitly configured per contract.
- SCCs: we have template SCCs and will execute per-customer.

Ben — can you confirm the current backup replication policy for EU-dedicated customers (are snapshots ever copied to a US region for DR)?

Lauren
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@eurofin.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procure@eurofin.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 07:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report and hosting boundary questions

Thanks Jonas — that helps. Procurement would like: 

1) The SOC 2 PDF (we'll accept redacted attachments)
2) The signed bridge letter covering controls from 2025-06-01 to delivery date
3) A clear statement whether backups or point-in-time snapshots containing customer data are stored outside the EU for customers who opt into "EU-only" hosting. If backups are replicated for DR, we need to know the region(s) and whether they're encrypted with EU-resident KMS keys.
4) Confirmation you will execute SCCs (or equivalent) and any standard annexes for data processing.

If you can include the Hosting_EU_Dataflow_Diagram and a short note on telemetry/log handling that would speed legal review. Procurement is at procure@eurofin.com.

Appreciate the quick turn on this.

Regards,
Marta

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@eurofin.com>, procure@eurofin.com
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report and hosting boundary questions

Marta / procurement team — attaching the items you requested. Summary answers inline below and attachments in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodCompliance

- SOC 2 Type II report: attached as SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025-05-31.pdf (we have redacted IP addresses; full copy available under NDA). Audit period: 2024-06-01 to 2025-05-31; report issued 2025-06-30.
- Bridge letter: attached Bridge_Letter_Euro_Transfers_2026-06-30.docx; signed by Head of Compliance. The bridge letter attests no material changes to control design or operation since 2025-06-01 through 2026-06-30.
- Hosting / backups: For customers that elect EU-only hosting, production inference, storage, and automated backups are retained in EU regions only. We replicate backups to a secondary EU region for resilience (example: eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1). We do not replicate EU-only customer backups to US regions unless the customer contractually requests and approves cross-region replication. All backups are encrypted at rest; for EU-only customers keys are managed in an EU KMS instance.
- Telemetry / logs: Aggregated telemetry (metrics and anonymized usage stats) may be processed outside the EU for product analytics; we do not include customer plaintext prompt/response content in that telemetry stream. Detailed request/response logs are stored according to the customer's region settings and access controls.
- SCCs / cross-border legal: we will execute EU SCCs (or equivalent) as part of our DPA. We can provide a template SCC addendum and an executed copy on signature.

Attachments included: SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025-05-31.pdf; Bridge_Letter_Euro_Transfers_2026-06-30.docx; Hosting_EU_Dataflow_Diagram.png

If procurement wants a SIG/CAIQ snapshot or a quick call with Compliance, we can schedule a 30-minute session this week. Let us know your availability.

Best,
Jonas
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2_Report_Redwood_2025-05-31.pdf (attachment), Bridge_Letter_Euro_Transfers_2026-06-30.docx (attachment), Hosting_EU_Dataflow_Diagram.png (attachment)
